model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden state means across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis represents the layer number, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 24, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the absolute mean, also on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Three lines are depicted: the blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate", the orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate", and the green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively stable around 0.2 until layer 10, and then exhibits a sharp increase to 4.5 at layer 24, with a notable jump between layers 18 and 20. The orange dotted line begins at 0 and remains nearly constant at 0 throughout the layers. The green solid line also starts at 0 and remains steady at 0 across all layers.
